tools.name: get_daily_drill
tools.description: Fetch today's Quant Daily drill (GRE Quantitative Reasoning · GMAT quant). Every conversation receives this same question, already checked to have one correct answer. Returns the exam, the difficulty and the expected time in seconds. Does not return the answer or the worked explanation. English only

tools.name: submit_drill_answer
tools.description: Submit one option id for a Quant Daily drill. Returns whether it is right or wrong and how many attempts remain. A wrong guess does not name the correct option. tools.name: get_drill_hint
tools.description: Name the drill type and ask for the first step on a Quant Daily question. Does not reveal the option or the worked explanation. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person.

tools.name: get_practice_drill
tools.description: Open one extra Quant Daily practice question, checked to have one correct answer. This conversation can open 2 practice questions today (the anonymous allowance). These are not today's shared drill and they are not in the attempt ranking. English only; lang hi is rejected.
